summary.text: Angela Rigas is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 79 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Hastings native and salon business owner, she serves on the House Oversight and Regulatory Reform committees.

paragraphs.text: Rigas was born in Hastings, Michigan, graduated from Hastings High School, and owned a salon business before entering the legislature.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Oversight Committee, the House Regulatory Reform Committee and a select committee on protecting Michigan employees and small businesses.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Zach Abbott in the general election on November 3, 2026.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Rigas described herself as a conservative and listed defending constitutional freedoms, empowering parents in education, and economic relief and fiscal responsibility as her key messages.
She said she is passionate about parental rights, election security, and regulatory reform.
